changelog: Isobaric atmospheric engine & barometric pressure simulation with moving depression and anticyclone fronts.
Human thermodynamics & felt temperature with altitude thermal loss, wind chill, and building/vehicle shelter detection.
Full 4-seasons calendar cycle with summer heat haze mirages, autumn winds, winter frost, and spring showers.
Live Doppler weather radar reflectivity simulation & civilian portable weather tablet (/meteo_tablet).
Aerodynamic flight turbulence in clouds/storms, helicopter urban windshear, and maritime boat drift.
Rare celestial phenomena: solar eclipses with twilight darkening, northern aurora borealis, and meteor showers.
Interactive San Andreas map in the admin panel (/conf_acn_weathertime) for visual zone creation and microclimates.
